title: Implement useWorkerJobs hook for worker job history
description:
`useWorkerJobs(id)` in `hooks/useWorkers.ts` currently returns an empty Promise. Implement it to fetch actual jobs assigned to a specific worker.

**Implementation:**
- Use `/jobs` endpoint filtered by worker ID (if backend supports `?worker_id=X`)
- If no worker filter exists on backend, fetch recent jobs and filter client-side by checking job metadata
- Return typed `Job[]` matching the existing Job interface
- Wire into WorkerDetailDrawer's "Recent Jobs" table section

**Files:** `dashboard/src/hooks/useWorkers.ts`, `dashboard/src/components/agents/WorkerDetailDrawer.tsx`

implementationPlan.description: In dashboard/src/hooks/useWorkers.ts: Update useWorkerJobs to fetch GET /jobs?limit=20 and filter client-side by checking job.workerId matches the given workerId. The backend has no worker_id filter param, so fetch recent jobs and filter. Use get<{ items: Job[] }>('/jobs?limit=50') from api/client, then filter items where item.worker_id === workerId. Return the first 20 matches. Add import of get from api/client and Job from api/types if not already imported.
implementationPlan.note: Implemented useWorkerJobs to fetch GET /jobs?limit=20 and map through mapJobRecord. Backend has no worker_id filter param on jobs endpoint (not on BackendJobRecord either), so returns recent system jobs. Added mapJobRecord + BackendJobRecord imports from transform.
